A.data: Existing JRA official SOURCE/corpus with admitted signer/OIDC provenance and approved Feature registry
A.eligible_only_if: Capture and witness before the target cutoff; race observations before the target race; runner/pedigree identity valid

B.data: New official historical recovery samples:9 profile occurrences/149 run identities under the documented diagnostic key
B.pending: Normal independent OIDC corpus intake; no direct Production import

C.data: Private Blood-B528 result races/7059 rows; research workbook/grouped summaries; quarantined official recovery until admission
C.provider_permission_statement: Present in original checkpoint; no new permission or public redistribution inferred

D.data: Current captures evaluated as if available for a historical2021-2025 prediction
D.handling: Excluded from historical pre-race/OOS evidence; actual2026 capture timestamp retained
D.may_be_future_eligible: Only under A admission and target-cutoff gates

E.data: Evidence with unknown origin/time, inconsistent identity or unverifiable member hash
E.handling: Reject or quarantine; never default toA

repeated_starts: Each valid horse/race row is an observation; independent offspring count is distinct from starts
population_dimensions: Existing per-feature sire/damsire/surface/distance/venue/class sample counts and missingness retained; these small cohorts do not certify national coverage
